title: Belt cleanup
description: An Old Works Scuttler is shadowing the ore haulers out of the Struvok belt. Cull it, dock at Jalvrek, and the bounty office settles the fee.

title: Supply run to Hauvnok
description: Hauvnok is short on ion rounds. Buy 200 rounds (1 m³) on the Jalvrek market and carry them to the Hauvnok hangar — one gate jump into the Fringe. The cargo is the delivery: do not spend it on the way.

title: Kerngrit order
description: Jalvrek's refinery needs 400 m³ of raw Kerngrit. Fill the ore hold at the Struvok belt and dock to turn the order in.
